extracted_constraints.clause: Requirement 1 (Issue #142340: [DiskBBQ] Fix our silly imbalanced cluster issue)
Cluster imbalance is a known issue and yeah, we are hitting it
I consistently see oversized clusters (multiples in size of our configured limit)
This can lead to inconsistent search latency behavior for different queries (what if the query is nearer only tiny cl...
) and can harm our logic for fetching postings lists
We should strive for cluster size consistency, even with SOAR overspilling
Requirement 2 (Issue #140470: Query planner rewrite SUM(X+a) as SUM(X) + a*COUNT(X))
We should be able to optimize stats of the form SUM(X + a) where a is a constant to SUM(X) + aCOUNT(X)
This should result in fewer addition operations, and reuse of SUM(X) if it is used elsewhere in the query
There is a problem with doing this optimization due to multivaluedness
Specifically, if a document has multiple values for X then X+a is null, and does not contribute to the result
For example if there are two documents one with X value 3 and one with values [5, 10], then the query STATS SUM(X), S...
Requirement 3 (Issue #144641: ES|QL: improve error message for unbounded sort before MV_EXPAND)
Some queries with SORT + MV_EXPAND can result in an unbounded sort, that cannot be executed for now
Current error message is Unbounded SORT not supported yet [SORT something] please add a LIMIT, that is too generic to...
We should make it more clear, explicitly mentioning the command (eg
MV_EXPAND) that caused the sort to remain unbounded, and suggest possible solutions
Requirement 4 (Issue #140103: [ES|QL] First/Last aliases and types)
This issue was created out of a small number of remaining work from that was deemed not necessary for a tech preview,...
Vector-only dispatch
Special handling for block values that can be vectorized has been disabled in it was a no-op
At some point, we'd like to enable it back and actually have it implemented for performance reasons as the vector pat...
Add support for date / data_nanos / float in the value parameter 3
Make aliases that default to @timestamp for the second parameter, and call them EARLIEST/LATEST
